<user_query>
You are the Design Architecture specialist in an SDLC pipeline.

You are a senior software architect. Transform the approved requirement analysis into a practical architecture update.

## Authorization
The user invoked /sdlc-orchestrator, which runs phases in order when each gate passes. Phase 1 (Requirements) PASSED. The orchestrator accepted assumptions A-1 through A-8. You ARE authorized to update architecture.md now. Do not ask for a second approval. Do not modify index.html, styles.css, welcome-page.test.mjs, impl-plan.md, or any production code.

## Workspace
c:\Users\Hariprasanth_Baskara\.cursor
Architecture file to update: c:\Users\Hariprasanth_Baskara\.cursor\plans\hari-agents\architecture.md
Requirements: c:\Users\Hariprasanth_Baskara\.cursor\plans\hari-agents\requirements.md
Current page: plans/hari-agents/index.html, styles.css, welcome-page.test.mjs

Read architecture.md and requirements.md fully before editing.

## Approved additive requirements (do not invent beyond these)
- FR-13: visible year token 2026 (not a longer digit run, not a comment-only year)
- FR-14: visible exact text "Page used for QA engineer" (singular, case-sensitive, trailing space not required)
- FR-15: both visible after load with no click, form, or API
- FR-16: keep title Hari-Agents, exactly one h1 Hari-Agents, greeting Welcome to Hari-Agents, tagline A personal agent workspace.
- Existing stack stays: plain HTML + CSS, no page JS, no backend, files under plans/hari-agents/
- Placement: additional visible body text inside the existing main. Do not change the document title. Do not add a second h1.
- Q-1 default: first-screen placement of the new lines is NOT mandatory; visible after load is enough. Prefer keeping them in main so they stay with the welcome content and typically remain in the first viewport because the page is short and centered.
- Do not add copyright wording unless it is the minimal phrase that contains 2026. A dedicated visible year line is enough, e.g. a paragraph whose text is 2026, plus a paragraph whose text is exactly Page used for QA engineer.
- welcome-page.test.mjs currently asserts main contains ONLY h1, greeting, and tagline. Architecture must note that the test contract must change to expect the two new paragraphs inside main, in a defined order, while still forbidding script, form, and remote URLs.

## Required architecture.md updates
Preserve existing structure and decisions AD-1 through AD-12. Add decisions for the new copy. Set document status to Proposed or Needs Review (NOT Approved) because Design Review has not re-run. Ready for implementation: No, until design review passes.

Update content sections that describe page copy, data shown, component responsibilities, and the HTML structure so they include:
- year paragraph: 2026
- instruction paragraph: Page used for QA engineer
Recommended order inside main:
1. h1 Hari-Agents
2. p Welcome to Hari-Agents
3. p A personal agent workspace.
4. p 2026
5. p Page used for QA engineer

Add a short note that contrast tokens stay #ffffff / #1a1a1a and no new technology is introduced.

Include or update a Mermaid context diagram if the existing one would become inconsistent. Keep Mermaid valid.

## Return to the orchestrator
After editing, report:
- File changed
- Decisions added (IDs)
- Whether the architecture addresses FR-13 through FR-16
- GATE: does architecture address the approved requirements? yes/no
- Any open decisions that would block design review
Do not claim design review passed.
</user_query>
I'll read the architecture and requirements documents first, then update the architecture to cover the approved copy changes.
